Overview

Introduction

USDK Profile Service JAR (artifact DeviceManagerNew) is the client JAR for Urovo/UBX enterprise device management. Package android.device. It talks to the system USDKPlus / com.ubx.usdk.profile service over Binder for device info, policy, network, apps, and logging.

ItemDetail
Version16.3.04 (build.gradle versionName)
PlatformAndroid (Java)
minSdk22
RecommendedAPI 29+ (Android 10+; Ex classes auto-bind without Context)
DevicesAndroid 10+ Urovo enterprise terminals (some APIs on Android 9 and below)

Version history

Current JAR version is 16.3.04 (build.gradle versionName).

Key Features

  • DeviceManager: SN/IMEI, APN, lock screen, Device Owner, silent install/uninstall, whitelists, traffic and memory stats (stub declarations).
  • DeviceManagerEx: Extended settings (brightness, volume, timezone, defaults), WiFi/hotspot, screensaver, Ethernet IP/proxy, screenshot, shell commands.
  • NetworkManagerEx: WiFi connect & INI tuning, dual-SIM defaults, manual carrier selection, per-slot APN, network policy locks.
  • ApplicationManagerEx: App enable/disable, runtime permissions, notification lists, battery optimization, launch-after-boot/install.
  • LogManagerEx: logcat by TAG/keyword, WiFi/crash dumps, MTK/QCOM offline logs.
  • DevicePolicyEnhancer: Silent update install, Bluetooth pairing.

Use Cases

  • MDM / remote terminal configuration
  • Mass deployment: silent install, default launcher, WiFi/APN preset
  • Ops diagnostics: log capture, traffic and power stats
  • Kiosk / lock task, key and USB control

Requirements

ItemRequirement
compileSdk31
Java1.8+
SystemUSDKPlus service and com.ubx.usdk.profile on device
Buildgradlew makeJar → release/DeviceManagerNew_v16.3.04_<YYMMdd>.jar

Integration

Obtain the SDK

  1. Run gradlew makeJar in this module.
  2. Copy release/DeviceManagerNew_v*.jar to your app libs/.
  3. Add to build.gradle:
gradle
dependencies {
    implementation files('libs/DeviceManagerNew_v16.3.04_xxxxxx.jar')
}

Project Setup

  • Permissions: Most operations run in the system service; declare network/storage permissions when writing log files.
  • ProGuard:
proguard
-keep class android.device.** { *; }
-keep class com.ubx.usdkplus.** { *; }
-keep class com.ubx.usdkenhancer.** { *; }
  • Runtime: DeviceManager is a stub; Ex classes use ServiceManager.getService("USDKPlus") or bind com.ubx.usdkplus.profileserviceplus.

Initialization

Android 10+ (API 29+)

java
DeviceManagerEx dm = new DeviceManagerEx();
NetworkManagerEx nm = new NetworkManagerEx();
ApplicationManagerEx am = new ApplicationManagerEx();
LogManagerEx lm = new LogManagerEx();

DeviceManager uses new DeviceManager() (stub replaced on device).

Android 9 and below

Use Context constructors for Ex classes. bindService is private in source; binding is triggered internally via InitListener.

java
Intent service = new Intent("com.ubx.usdkplus.profileserviceplus");
service.setPackage("com.ubx.usdk.profile");

Auth/keys: None (relies on system service and ROM privileges).

Quick Start

Read device SN and set WiFi country code (Android 10+):

java
import android.device.DeviceManager;
import android.device.DeviceManagerEx;
import android.device.NetworkManagerEx;

public class QuickDemo {
    public void run() {
        DeviceManager dm = new DeviceManager();
        String sn = dm.getDeviceId();

        DeviceManagerEx dmEx = new DeviceManagerEx();
        NetworkManagerEx nmEx = new NetworkManagerEx();

        dmEx.controlCamera(false);
        nmEx.setWifiCountryCode("US");
    }
}

DeviceManager.setAPN

Sets apn.

Method

java
public boolean setAPN(String name, String apn, String proxy, int port, String user, String server, String password, String mmsc, String mcc, String mnc, String mmsproxy, int mmsport, int authtype, String type, String protocol, int bearer, String roamingprotocol, boolean current)

Parameters

NameTypeDescription
nameStringRequired. Entry name. Cannot be null.
apnStringRequired. APN name. Cannot be null.
proxyStringProxy address.
portintProxy port.
userStringAPN username.
serverStringServer address.
passwordStringAPN password.
mmscStringMMSC URL.
mccStringRequired. Mobile Country Code (MCC). Cannot be null.
mncStringRequired. MNC Mobile Network Code (MNC). Cannot be null.
mmsproxyStringMMS proxy address.
mmsportintMMS proxy port.
authtypeintAuthentication type. Value:
typeStringComma-delimited list of APN types.
protocolStringThe protocol to use to connect to this APN. Value: IPv6 or IPv4.
bearerintBEARER Radio Access Technology info. Value:
roamingprotocolStringThe protocol to use to connect to this APN when roaming.
currentbooleanEnable current APN.

Returns

boolean — the apn

Example

DeviceManager dm = new DeviceManager();

DeviceManager.putIni

Set the wifi parameter. • MTK projects: &nbsp(1)gParamPowerMode:power saving mode,0:close 2:open； &nbsp(2)MTK_WifiBand（CT48 is gWifiBandType）:wifi band,0:2.4G/5G 1:5G 2:2.4G； &nbsp(3)RoamingRcpiHi:frequency band roaming first threshold,110-value/2 within the range of 60-90； &nbsp(4)RoamingRCPIGoodValue:roaming threshold,110-value/2 within the range of 60-90； &nbsp(5)RoamingRCPIPoorValue:roaming low threshold,110-value/2 within the range of 60-90； &nbsp(6)RoamingRCPIDelta0:roaming value-added,within the range of 4-20； &nbsp(7)RoamingRCPIDelta1:roaming value-added1,within the range of 4-20； • Qualcomm projects: &nbsp(1)QCOM_PowerSave:power saving mode,set QCOM_PowerSave to 0,1,2； &nbsp&nbsp gEnableImps:power saving mode when not connected,0:open,1:close； &nbsp&nbsp gEnableBmps:power saving mode under connection,0:open,1:close； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 0:gEnableImps=0,gEnableBmps=0； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 1:gEnableImps=1,gEnableBmps=0； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 2:gEnableImps=1,gEnableBmps=1； &nbsp(2)gNeighborLookupThreshold:roaming threshold,within the range of 58-100； &nbsp(3)RoamRssiDiff:roaming sensitivity,within the range of 3-20； &nbsp(4)QCOM_WifiBand:wifi band,0:2.4G/5G,1:2.4G,2:5G。set QCOM_WifiBand to 0,1,2； &nbsp&nbsp BandCapability:wifi band,0:2.4G/5G 1:2.4G 2:5G； &nbsp&nbsp gRoamIntraBand:0:cross band roaming,1:roaming within the frequency band; &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 0:BandCapability=0,gRoamIntraBand=0； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 1:BandCapability=1,gRoamIntraBand=1； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 2:BandCapability=2,gRoamIntraBand=1； &nbsp(5)gDot11Mode:protocol supported by WIFI； &nbsp&nbsp 0:auto； &nbsp&nbsp 1:802.11a、b、g； &nbsp&nbsp 2:802.11b； &nbsp&nbsp 3:802.11g； &nbsp&nbsp 4:802.11n； &nbsp&nbsp 5:only 802.11g； &nbsp&nbsp 6:only 802.11n； &nbsp&nbsp 7:only 802.11b; &nbsp&nbsp 8:only 802.11ac； &nbsp&nbsp 9:802.11ac； &nbsp(6)gRoamPrefer5GHz:5G priority mode switch,0:open,1:close； &nbsp(7)gSelect5GHzMargin:Under the condition of 5G priority, compare how much dB 2.4g is better than 5g before roaming to 2.4g,within the range of 0-100； &nbsp(8)gRrmEnable:802.11k support,0:support,1:not Supported； &nbsp(9)g11dSupportEnabled:802.11d support,0:support,1:not Supported； &nbsp(10)FastTransitionEnabled:FT mode（802.11r、Fast Roaming）,0:close,1:open；

Method

java
public void putIni(String name, String value)

Parameters

NameTypeDescription
nameStringthe wifi parameter name
valueStringthe value

Example

java
DeviceManager dm = new DeviceManager();
dm.putIni("value", "value");

NetworkManagerEx.putIni

Set the wifi parameter. • MTK projects: &nbsp(1)gParamPowerMode:power saving mode,0:close 2:open； &nbsp(2)MTK_WifiBand（CT48 is gWifiBandType）:wifi band,0:2.4G/5G 1:5G 2:2.4G； &nbsp(3)RoamingRcpiHi:frequency band roaming first threshold,110-value/2 within the range of 60-90； &nbsp(4)RoamingRCPIGoodValue:roaming threshold,110-value/2 within the range of 60-90； &nbsp(5)RoamingRCPIPoorValue:roaming low threshold,110-value/2 within the range of 60-90； &nbsp(6)RoamingRCPIDelta0:roaming value-added,within the range of 4-20； &nbsp(7)RoamingRCPIDelta1:roaming value-added1,within the range of 4-20； • Qualcomm projects: &nbsp(1)QCOM_PowerSave:power saving mode,set QCOM_PowerSave to 0,1,2； &nbsp&nbsp gEnableImps:power saving mode when not connected,0:open,1:close； &nbsp&nbsp gEnableBmps:power saving mode under connection,0:open,1:close； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 0:gEnableImps=0,gEnableBmps=0； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 1:gEnableImps=1,gEnableBmps=0； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 2:gEnableImps=1,gEnableBmps=1； &nbsp(2)gNeighborLookupThreshold:roaming threshold,within the range of 58-100； &nbsp(3)RoamRssiDiff:roaming sensitivity,within the range of 3-20； &nbsp(4)QCOM_WifiBand:wifi band,0:2.4G/5G,1:2.4G,2:5G。set QCOM_WifiBand to 0,1,2； &nbsp&nbsp BandCapability:wifi band,0:2.4G/5G 1:2.4G 2:5G； &nbsp&nbsp gRoamIntraBand:0:cross band roaming,1:roaming within the frequency band; &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 0:BandCapability=0,gRoamIntraBand=0； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 1:BandCapability=1,gRoamIntraBand=1； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 2:BandCapability=2,gRoamIntraBand=1； &nbsp(5)gDot11Mode:protocol supported by WIFI； &nbsp&nbsp 0:auto； &nbsp&nbsp 1:802.11a、b、g； &nbsp&nbsp 2:802.11b； &nbsp&nbsp 3:802.11g； &nbsp&nbsp 4:802.11n； &nbsp&nbsp 5:only 802.11g； &nbsp&nbsp 6:only 802.11n； &nbsp&nbsp 7:only 802.11b; &nbsp&nbsp 8:only 802.11ac； &nbsp&nbsp 9:802.11ac； &nbsp(6)gRoamPrefer5GHz:5G priority mode switch,0:open,1:close； &nbsp(7)gSelect5GHzMargin:Under the condition of 5G priority, compare how much dB 2.4g is better than 5g before roaming to 2.4g,within the range of 0-100； &nbsp(8)gRrmEnable:802.11k support,0:support,1:not Supported； &nbsp(9)g11dSupportEnabled:802.11d support,0:support,1:not Supported； &nbsp(10)FastTransitionEnabled:FT mode（802.11r、Fast Roaming）,0:close,1:open；

Method

java
public void putIni(String name, String value)

Parameters

NameTypeDescription
nameStringthe wifi parameter name
valueStringthe value

Example

java
NetworkManagerEx nmEx = new NetworkManagerEx();
nmEx.putIni("value", "value");

异步扫描可用运营商列表（与系统设置「选择网络」加载过程一致，需数秒）。 扫描过程中 INetworkScanCallback#onScanResults 可能被多次调用（约每 3 秒）， 结束后调用 INetworkScanCallback#onScanComplete 或 INetworkScanCallback#onScanError(int)。 本方法立即返回；回调在 Binder 线程执行，更新 UI 请切换到主线程。

    @Override public void onScanResults(java.util.List<com.ubx.usdkplus.NetworkOperatorInfo> networks) { }
    @Override public void onScanComplete() { }
    @Override public void onScanError(int errorCode) { }
});

NetworkManagerEx.selectManualNetwork

手动选择运营商网络（会自动关闭「自动选择网络」）。 注意：本方法会阻塞调用线程等待 modem，可能耗时数秒~15 秒，禁止在 Activity 主线程调用， 否则会导致 ANR。请在后台线程 / 线程池 / 协程 IO 调度器中调用。 返回 true 表示 modem 已接受选网指令，不代表已完成驻网；详见接口文档 3.3.29。 扫描结果中 forbidden=true 的 PLMN 会直接返回 false。 返回 true 后若长时间无变化，与系统设置手动选网表现一致，可能为驻网失败或 PLMN 未变。

Examples

Per-slot APN with preferred selection

java
NetworkManagerEx nm = new NetworkManagerEx();
boolean ok = nm.setTargetSimApn(
        0, "MyAPN", "internet", "", 0, "", "", "", "460", "01",
        "", 0, 0, "default", "IPV4V6", 0, "IPV4V6", true);
String listJson = nm.listTargetSimApn(0);

Use setTargetSimCurrentApnById for precise selection when duplicate names exist.

Manual carrier selection (background thread)

java
new Thread(() -> {
    NetworkManagerEx nm = new NetworkManagerEx();
    nm.startNetworkScan(0, callback);
    nm.selectManualNetwork(0, "46011", "China Telecom");
}).start();

Do not call setNetworkSelectionAutomatic / selectManualNetwork on the main thread (modem blocking, ANR risk).

App permissions and upgrade blocklist

java
ApplicationManagerEx am = new ApplicationManagerEx();
am.grantRuntimePermission("com.example.app", "android.permission.CAMERA");
am.setDisallowAppUpgrade("com.example.app", 1);

Notes & FAQ

Notes

  • Threading: NetworkManagerEx.setNetworkSelectionAutomatic, selectManualNetwork, setPreferredNetworkType may block on modem — use a worker thread.
  • Lifecycle: Ex classes re-bind on Binder death where DeathRecipient is implemented.
  • Stub: DeviceManager methods throw RuntimeException("stub"); real impl is on device ROM.
  • Hardware: WiFi INI keys differ for MTK vs Qualcomm; offline log dirs differ by platform.

FAQ

Q: Methods return false or null?

A: Verify USDKPlus service exists; on Android 9 and below use Context constructors for Ex classes.

Q: DeviceManager vs DeviceManagerEx?

A: DeviceManager is the legacy stub surface; DeviceManagerEx uses Binder for extended enterprise APIs.

Q: How to capture WiFi logs?

A: LogManagerEx.startWifiLogCapture or startLogCaptureByKeywords with DEFAULT_WIFI_LOG_KEYWORDS.

概述

SDK 简介

USDK Profile Service JAR（产物名 DeviceManagerNew）是 Urovo/UBX 行业终端设备管理 SDK 的客户端 JAR 库，包名 android.device。通过 Binder 连接系统侧 USDKPlus / com.ubx.usdk.profile 服务，提供设备信息、系统策略、网络、应用、日志等管理能力。

项目说明
当前版本16.3.04（build.gradle versionName）
平台Android（Java）
最低 API22（Android 5.1）
推荐 API29+（Android 10+，Ex 类无 Context 构造自动绑定）
目标机型Android 10 及以上 Urovo 行业终端（部分接口兼容 Android 9 及以下）

版本变更

当前 JAR 版本为 16.3.04（build.gradle versionName）。

核心能力

  • DeviceManager：设备 SN/IMEI、APN、锁屏、Device Owner、静默装卸载、白名单策略、流量与内存统计等基础能力（Stub 接口声明）。
  • DeviceManagerEx：扩展系统设置（亮度、音量、时区、默认应用等）、WiFi/热点配置、屏保、以太网 IP/代理、截图、Shell 命令等。
  • NetworkManagerEx：WiFi 连接与 INI 参数、双卡默认卡槽、运营商手动选网、按卡槽 APN 管理、网络策略限制等。
  • ApplicationManagerEx：应用启停、运行时权限授予/撤销、通知黑白名单、电池优化、开机/安装拉起等。
  • LogManagerEx：按 TAG/关键字 logcat 采集、WiFi/崩溃日志 dump、MTK/QCOM 离线日志。
  • DevicePolicyEnhancer：静默系统升级安装、蓝牙静默配对。

适用场景

  • MDM / 行业应用远程配置终端
  • 批量部署：静默安装、默认 Launcher、WiFi/ APN 预置
  • 运维诊断：日志采集、流量与电量统计
  • kiosk / 锁任务模式、按键与 USB 管控

环境要求

项目要求
编译 SDKcompileSdk 31
Java1.8+
系统服务设备需预装 USDKPlus 系统服务及 com.ubx.usdk.profile Profile Service
构建产物gradlew makeJar → release/DeviceManagerNew_v16.3.04_<YYMMdd>.jar

接入

获取 SDK

  1. 在本模块目录执行 gradlew makeJar（Windows：gradlew.bat makeJar）。
  2. 将 release/ 下生成的 DeviceManagerNew_v*.jar 拷贝到应用工程的 libs/ 目录。
  3. 在应用 build.gradle 中添加：
gradle
dependencies {
    implementation files('libs/DeviceManagerNew_v16.3.04_xxxxxx.jar')
}

工程配置

  • 权限：多数能力由系统服务代执行，应用侧通常无需额外声明特殊权限；涉及网络、存储日志路径时需按 Android 版本声明相应权限。
  • ProGuard：JAR 含 AIDL 生成类与 android.device.*，混淆时建议 keep：
proguard
-keep class android.device.** { *; }
-keep class com.ubx.usdkplus.** { *; }
-keep class com.ubx.usdkenhancer.** { *; }
  • 系统依赖：DeviceManager 为 Stub，实际逻辑在设备 ROM；Ex 类通过 ServiceManager.getService("USDKPlus") 或 bind com.ubx.usdkplus.profileserviceplus 获取 Binder。

初始化

Android 10+（API 29+）

无参构造会自动反射获取 USDKPlus 服务：

java
DeviceManagerEx dm = new DeviceManagerEx();
NetworkManagerEx nm = new NetworkManagerEx();
ApplicationManagerEx am = new ApplicationManagerEx();
LogManagerEx lm = new LogManagerEx();

DeviceManager 直接使用 new DeviceManager()（Stub，由系统替换实现）。

Android 9 及以下

Ex 类须使用 Context 构造；源码中 bindService 为 private，内部通过 InitListener 触发绑定。

服务 Intent：

java
Intent service = new Intent("com.ubx.usdkplus.profileserviceplus");
service.setPackage("com.ubx.usdk.profile");

鉴权/密钥：无（依赖系统服务与 ROM 签名权限）。

快速开始

获取设备 SN 并设置 WiFi 国家码（Android 10+）：

java
import android.device.DeviceManager;
import android.device.DeviceManagerEx;
import android.device.NetworkManagerEx;

public class QuickDemo {
    public void run() {
        DeviceManager dm = new DeviceManager();
        String sn = dm.getDeviceId();

        DeviceManagerEx dmEx = new DeviceManagerEx();
        NetworkManagerEx nmEx = new NetworkManagerEx();

        dmEx.controlCamera(false);
        nmEx.setWifiCountryCode("CN");
    }
}

DeviceManager.putIni

Set the wifi parameter. • MTK projects: &nbsp(1)gParamPowerMode:power saving mode,0:close 2:open； &nbsp(2)MTK_WifiBand（CT48 is gWifiBandType）:wifi band,0:2.4G/5G 1:5G 2:2.4G； &nbsp(3)RoamingRcpiHi:frequency band roaming first threshold,110-value/2 within the range of 60-90； &nbsp(4)RoamingRCPIGoodValue:roaming threshold,110-value/2 within the range of 60-90； &nbsp(5)RoamingRCPIPoorValue:roaming low threshold,110-value/2 within the range of 60-90； &nbsp(6)RoamingRCPIDelta0:roaming value-added,within the range of 4-20； &nbsp(7)RoamingRCPIDelta1:roaming value-added1,within the range of 4-20； • Qualcomm projects: &nbsp(1)QCOM_PowerSave:power saving mode,set QCOM_PowerSave to 0,1,2； &nbsp&nbsp gEnableImps:power saving mode when not connected,0:open,1:close； &nbsp&nbsp gEnableBmps:power saving mode under connection,0:open,1:close； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 0:gEnableImps=0,gEnableBmps=0； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 1:gEnableImps=1,gEnableBmps=0； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 2:gEnableImps=1,gEnableBmps=1； &nbsp(2)gNeighborLookupThreshold:roaming threshold,within the range of 58-100； &nbsp(3)RoamRssiDiff:roaming sensitivity,within the range of 3-20； &nbsp(4)QCOM_WifiBand:wifi band,0:2.4G/5G,1:2.4G,2:5G。set QCOM_WifiBand to 0,1,2； &nbsp&nbsp BandCapability:wifi band,0:2.4G/5G 1:2.4G 2:5G； &nbsp&nbsp gRoamIntraBand:0:cross band roaming,1:roaming within the frequency band; &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 0:BandCapability=0,gRoamIntraBand=0； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 1:BandCapability=1,gRoamIntraBand=1； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 2:BandCapability=2,gRoamIntraBand=1； &nbsp(5)gDot11Mode:protocol supported by WIFI； &nbsp&nbsp 0:auto； &nbsp&nbsp 1:802.11a、b、g； &nbsp&nbsp 2:802.11b； &nbsp&nbsp 3:802.11g； &nbsp&nbsp 4:802.11n； &nbsp&nbsp 5:only 802.11g； &nbsp&nbsp 6:only 802.11n； &nbsp&nbsp 7:only 802.11b; &nbsp&nbsp 8:only 802.11ac； &nbsp&nbsp 9:802.11ac； &nbsp(6)gRoamPrefer5GHz:5G priority mode switch,0:open,1:close； &nbsp(7)gSelect5GHzMargin:Under the condition of 5G priority, compare how much dB 2.4g is better than 5g before roaming to 2.4g,within the range of 0-100； &nbsp(8)gRrmEnable:802.11k support,0:support,1:not Supported； &nbsp(9)g11dSupportEnabled:802.11d support,0:support,1:not Supported； &nbsp(10)FastTransitionEnabled:FT mode（802.11r、Fast Roaming）,0:close,1:open；

方法

java
public void putIni(String name, String value)

参数

参数类型说明
nameStringthe wifi parameter name
valueStringthe value

示例

java
DeviceManager dm = new DeviceManager();
dm.putIni("value", "value");

NetworkManagerEx.putIni

Set the wifi parameter. • MTK projects: &nbsp(1)gParamPowerMode:power saving mode,0:close 2:open； &nbsp(2)MTK_WifiBand（CT48 is gWifiBandType）:wifi band,0:2.4G/5G 1:5G 2:2.4G； &nbsp(3)RoamingRcpiHi:frequency band roaming first threshold,110-value/2 within the range of 60-90； &nbsp(4)RoamingRCPIGoodValue:roaming threshold,110-value/2 within the range of 60-90； &nbsp(5)RoamingRCPIPoorValue:roaming low threshold,110-value/2 within the range of 60-90； &nbsp(6)RoamingRCPIDelta0:roaming value-added,within the range of 4-20； &nbsp(7)RoamingRCPIDelta1:roaming value-added1,within the range of 4-20； • Qualcomm projects: &nbsp(1)QCOM_PowerSave:power saving mode,set QCOM_PowerSave to 0,1,2； &nbsp&nbsp gEnableImps:power saving mode when not connected,0:open,1:close； &nbsp&nbsp gEnableBmps:power saving mode under connection,0:open,1:close； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 0:gEnableImps=0,gEnableBmps=0； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 1:gEnableImps=1,gEnableBmps=0； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 2:gEnableImps=1,gEnableBmps=1； &nbsp(2)gNeighborLookupThreshold:roaming threshold,within the range of 58-100； &nbsp(3)RoamRssiDiff:roaming sensitivity,within the range of 3-20； &nbsp(4)QCOM_WifiBand:wifi band,0:2.4G/5G,1:2.4G,2:5G。set QCOM_WifiBand to 0,1,2； &nbsp&nbsp BandCapability:wifi band,0:2.4G/5G 1:2.4G 2:5G； &nbsp&nbsp gRoamIntraBand:0:cross band roaming,1:roaming within the frequency band; &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 0:BandCapability=0,gRoamIntraBand=0； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 1:BandCapability=1,gRoamIntraBand=1； &nbsp&nbsp&nbsp 2:BandCapability=2,gRoamIntraBand=1； &nbsp(5)gDot11Mode:protocol supported by WIFI； &nbsp&nbsp 0:auto； &nbsp&nbsp 1:802.11a、b、g； &nbsp&nbsp 2:802.11b； &nbsp&nbsp 3:802.11g； &nbsp&nbsp 4:802.11n； &nbsp&nbsp 5:only 802.11g； &nbsp&nbsp 6:only 802.11n； &nbsp&nbsp 7:only 802.11b; &nbsp&nbsp 8:only 802.11ac； &nbsp&nbsp 9:802.11ac； &nbsp(6)gRoamPrefer5GHz:5G priority mode switch,0:open,1:close； &nbsp(7)gSelect5GHzMargin:Under the condition of 5G priority, compare how much dB 2.4g is better than 5g before roaming to 2.4g,within the range of 0-100； &nbsp(8)gRrmEnable:802.11k support,0:support,1:not Supported； &nbsp(9)g11dSupportEnabled:802.11d support,0:support,1:not Supported； &nbsp(10)FastTransitionEnabled:FT mode（802.11r、Fast Roaming）,0:close,1:open；

方法

java
public void putIni(String name, String value)

参数

参数类型说明
nameStringthe wifi parameter name
valueStringthe value

示例

java
NetworkManagerEx nmEx = new NetworkManagerEx();
nmEx.putIni("value", "value");

    @Override public void onScanResults(java.util.List<com.ubx.usdkplus.NetworkOperatorInfo> networks) { }
    @Override public void onScanComplete() { }
    @Override public void onScanError(int errorCode) { }
});

类型与回调

InitListener

ValueMeaning
NO_SERVICE服务不可用
SUCCESS绑定成功
RELEASE已释放

INetworkScanCallback

MethodDescription
void onScanResults(List<NetworkOperatorInfo> networks)扫描中间/最终结果（可能多次，约 3 秒间隔）
void onScanComplete()扫描结束
void onScanError(int errorCode)扫描失败

NetworkOperatorInfo

Field说明
operatorName运营商显示名
operatorNumericPLMN（MCC+MNC）
radioTechnology制式，如 LTE、5G
connected是否当前连接
forbidden是否禁止注册
signalLevel信号 0–4，-1 未知

类型与数据模型

EthernetIpSettings

以太网 IP 配置（DHCP/静态）。

Field说明
modeAssignmentMode.DHCP 或 STATIC
ipAddress / prefixLength / gateway / dns1 / dns2静态 IP 参数

LogManagerEx 常量（节选）

常量说明
LOG_BUFFER_ALL全部缓冲区
DEFAULT_WIFI_LOG_KEYWORDSWiFi 默认关键字
MTK_LOG_ALL / QCOM_LOG_OPTIONAL_ALL离线日志类型掩码

示例

按卡槽配置 APN 并设为首选

java
NetworkManagerEx nm = new NetworkManagerEx();
boolean ok = nm.setTargetSimApn(
        0, "MyAPN", "internet", "", 0, "", "", "", "460", "01",
        "", 0, 0, "default", "IPV4V6", 0, "IPV4V6", true);
String listJson = nm.listTargetSimApn(0);

要点：current=true 同时设为首选；精确切换可用 setTargetSimCurrentApnById。

手动选择运营商（后台线程）

java
new Thread(() -> {
    NetworkManagerEx nm = new NetworkManagerEx();
    nm.startNetworkScan(0, callback);
    nm.selectManualNetwork(0, "46011", "中国电信");
}).start();

要点：setNetworkSelectionAutomatic、selectManualNetwork 禁止在主线程调用（可能阻塞数秒导致 ANR）。

应用权限与白名单

java
ApplicationManagerEx am = new ApplicationManagerEx();
am.grantRuntimePermission("com.example.app", "android.permission.CAMERA");
am.setDisallowAppUpgrade("com.example.app", 1);

注意事项与 FAQ

注意事项

  • 线程：NetworkManagerEx.setNetworkSelectionAutomatic、selectManualNetwork、setPreferredNetworkType 等可能阻塞 modem，须在后台线程执行。
  • 生命周期：Ex 类在 Binder 死亡时会尝试重绑（ApplicationManagerEx / DeviceManagerEx 已实现 DeathRecipient）。
  • Stub：DeviceManager 方法体为 throw new RuntimeException("stub")，实际运行在设备 ROM 注入的实现中。
  • 机型差异：WiFi INI 参数分 MTK / Qualcomm 两套；离线日志路径 OFFLINE_LOG_DIR_MTK / OFFLINE_LOG_DIR_QCOM 因平台而异。

FAQ

Q: 调用返回 false 或空值？

A: 先确认设备已安装 USDK Profile Service，且 ServiceManager.getService("USDKPlus") 非空；Android 9 及以下需使用 Context 构造 Ex 类。

Q: DeviceManager 与 DeviceManagerEx 区别？

A: DeviceManager 为传统 Stub 全量 API；DeviceManagerEx 通过 Binder 访问扩展服务，含更多系统设置与行业特性。

Q: 如何采集 WiFi 日志？

A: 使用 LogManagerEx.startWifiLogCapture 或 startLogCaptureByKeywords 配合 DEFAULT_WIFI_LOG_KEYWORDS。
